title: HLS Video Rendition
description: A piece of video content, made accessible via HLS.

id.description: The unique identifier for the rendition.

videoCodec.description: The video codec used for the rendition.

audioCodec.description: The audio codec used for the rendition.

maxBitrate.description: In the case of ABR transport protocols, the maximum bitrate of the rendition in bits per second.

minBitrate.description: In the case of ABR transport protocols, the minimum bitrate of the rendition in bits per second.

frameRate.description: The frame rate of the rendition in frames per second.

scanType.description: The scan type of the rendition, e.g., 'progressive' or 'interlaced'.

aspectRatio.description: The aspect ratio of the rendition, e.g., '16:9'.

width.description: The width of the rendition video content in pixels.

height.description: The height of the rendition video content in pixels.

href.description: A URL to access or request the rendition video content.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the rendition.
